system.description: For making Attack Skill Checks with explosives. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you safely handle standard explosive devices. On Fail, I'm sure the GM will think of something.

upgrades.description: You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of explosives you handle.
You are able to craft explosives such as dynamite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper's Table.
You may create explosive raw materials out of non-volatile materials. Your crafting takes half the time.
